title: Grateful Dead Live at St. Paul Civic Center on 1982-08-06

ai_review.summary: Front‑row audience tape captures a scorching ’82 Minnesota show with smoking Scarlet > Fire, tight jams and high energy, delivered in excellent sound.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers an almost front‑row experience, with superb instrumental balance and just enough boom to feel the heat of that sweltering St. Paul night. The performance is a 21‑song monster – Bertha opens the fire, Scarlet > Fire ignites the set, Candyman showcases Jerry’s vocal flair and Lost Sailor > Saint of Circumstance shines, all wrapped in high‑energy jams and seamless transitions. While reviewers note a slight need to boost Phil’s bass and tame crowd bleed, the overall audio quality is excellent and the show is universally praised.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 5) and enthusiastic comments about both the musical performance and the audio quality indicate an exceptional show with excellent audience recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Boomy front‑row feel, superb instrumental balance, occasional need to raise Phil's bass and lower crowd bleed; overall crisp and immersive.

standout_songs: Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain
show_quality.setlist_flow: A 21‑song monster with smooth transitions; early songs lock in quickly and give way to expansive jams (space before drums) that keep the energy high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocal inflections on Candyman praised; guitar 'sizzles' during Fire on the Mountain and delivers outer‑space themed jams.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass strength highlighted, especially leading into Fire on the Mountain; reviewers suggest boosting his level in the mix.
band_member_comments.Drums: Space jam before drums noted as a favorite early‑80s mix‑up jam, contributing to the show’s high energy.
